meta.title: Online re-enrolment
meta.description: Re-enrol with your school in a few minutes, without travelling.

hero.title: Your re-enrolment, in three minutes.
hero.subtitle: Have your student number and date of birth to hand. We pass your request to your school, and they get back to you.

choix.title: Your school
choix.aide: Pick the school where you are enrolled this year.

aucun.titre: No school has opened online re-enrolment yet.
aucun.texte: Get in touch with your registrar, who will tell you how to proceed.

identification.aide: Both details appear on your student card and on your report cards.

matricule.label: Student number
matricule.aide: Exactly as printed on your student card.

confirmation.consentement: I allow these details to be sent to my school so my re-enrolment can be processed.

succes.texte: Your school will review it and get back to you. Nothing further is required on your side.
succes.rappel: Keep your student number: you will need it to follow up with the registrar.

dejaDeposee.titre: Your request is already on file.
dejaDeposee.texte: Your school has received it and is reviewing it. No need to send it again.

nonEligible.texte: Your school has already re-enrolled you for this year. Contact the registrar if that surprises you.

introuvable.texte: Check your student number and date of birth. If they are correct, contact your registrar: your file may not yet be eligible for online re-enrolment.

ferme.texte: Your school has not opened the online re-enrolment window yet, or it has closed. Contact your registrar.

tropDeTentatives.texte: Please wait a few minutes before trying again.

indisponible.texte: We cannot reach your school right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

champsInvalides.texte: Enter your student number and your full date of birth.

refus.titre: Your request could not be recorded.
refus.texte: Contact your registrar: only they can tell you why and what to do next.

confiance.titre: What we do with your details
points: Your student number and date of birth are used only to find your file.
No financial information passes through this page, in either direction.
Your request is not an enrolment: your school decides, and your school replies.
